response_summary: Created and verified the AEGIS threat model and Phase 1 delivery plan, documenting trust boundaries, twelve threat scenarios, current evidence limits, dependencies, acceptance criteria and privileged-release stop conditions.

Ported the reviewed SQLite security-store descriptor-leak fix to the assigned branch and added a regression proving a rejected hard-linked database descriptor is closed without altering the external target; opened scoped task issue #80.

Closed a policy enforcement gap: registry rate_limit declarations were structurally validated but not enforced by any durable limiter, so configured limits now fail closed with a stable denial; added positive/negative regression coverage and documented the limitation.
Closed the SQLite connection when SecurityStore construction fails after connect (including PRAGMA/schema setup), with deterministic injected-failure regression proving the connection is closed.

Completed a source-level audit-event lifecycle coverage matrix against the normative authorization lifecycle and both audit schema versions; documented missing or ambiguous presentation, dismissal, invalidation, revocation, consume and reconciliation event coverage without changing shared contracts.

Completed the field-level audit-event v0.1.0/v0.2.0 required, nullable and conditional field review; recorded schema-test source coverage and incorporated NEXUS-07 event ownership and reconciliation guidance without changing shared contracts.

Completed a read-only review of approval and authorization state transitions against runtime source and tests; documented existing coverage, prioritized failure/race/expiry test gaps, and clarified the unresolved authorized-versus-consumed audit event semantic without changing runtime or shared contracts.

Reviewed security patches from the divergent legacy branch individually and selectively ported broker fail-closed checks, audit-chain SQLite error handling, and strict audit reason-code validation with regressions; confirmed exact-head GitHub Actions security tests passed.

Fixed an authorization issuance audit-failure path that could leave a SQLite transaction open; added a regression proving rollback leaves no authorization reference and preserves APPROVED state, then confirmed security and unified GitHub Actions validation passed.

Added an authorization re-issuance regression proving each newly issued reference revokes its predecessor, the revoked reference cannot consume, and only the latest reference can be consumed; exact-head security, unified and release-manifest CI all passed.

Added a precise approval-expiry boundary regression: a decision one microsecond before expires_at is accepted, persisted as APPROVED, timestamped in the audit event, and leaves a valid audit chain. Exact code-head security, unified and release-manifest CI passed.

Added policy-recheck exception regressions for authorization issuance and consumption. An issuance callback exception rolls back without minting a reference; a consume callback exception returns AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE and preserves the approved request and issued reference. Security contract, unified validation and release-manifest workflows passed on the exact code head.
